sources.title: Japan Embassy Washington short-term visa instructions

rules.text: Printed photo is 2 by 2 inches. 300 dpi is a selected output density, not an embassy requirement.
Capture against a plain background.
Taken within the past six months.
Use passport photo paper, not regular printer paper.
Attach with glue only; do not staple or tape.
No filters have been used.

edit_policy.notes: Source explicitly prohibits filters. Superaster conservatively blocks subject/background/identity-changing operations because source does not affirm their permission. Cropping/resizing are unspecified; confirm with this submitting mission. General MOFA form lists 35 by 45 mm, so this record is limited to Washington instructions. Retake against the required background if necessary.

user_confirmations: This is the Washington in-person channel

channel: Paper submission for procedures requiring the ISA photo specification

rules.text: Printed photo is 30 by 40 mm. 300 dpi is an output choice, not a mandated ISA density.
Diagram: hair-inclusive head to chin 25±3 mm; top margin 5±3 mm; horizontal center 15±2 mm.
Only applicant, frontal without hat, face clear, sharp image, no background or background/face shadows. See sourced religious/medical exception.
Taken within six months before submission.
Name on reverse; direct application-form printing exception depends on procedure.
No identity-changing edits; photo is not horizontally mirrored.

edit_policy.notes: ISA forbids changes to appearance such as enlarged eyes, whitened skin, modified facial features, moles or wrinkles, and horizontal reversal. Background replacement/cropping/resizing are unspecified; do not infer permission from an absent background requirement. Use retake or source review when required changes lack authorization.

exceptions: Religious/medical face coverings require the face to remain clear and an explanatory statement in any format. Do not remove coverings.
user_confirmations: Current truthful appearance without identity edits
Name on reverse or verified direct-print exception
Correct procedure requires this paper profile

sources.title: HM Passport Office digital photo guidance

rules.text: At least 600 wide and 750 high.
Authority says at least 50KB without defining unit basis. Below 50,000 fails; 50,000 to 51,199 needs review; at least 51,200 clears either unit interpretation.
Authority says no more than 10MB without defining unit basis. At most 10,000,000 clears either interpretation; up to 10,485,760 needs review; beyond fails.
Photo is unaltered by software. Preserve original bytes for submission.
New photo taken within the last month.
Colour, clear and focused; plain light background, subject contrast, no shadows or red eye.
Only applicant, facing camera, eyes visible without covering hair, closed mouth and plain expression; no face obstruction. See age/covering/glasses exceptions.
Include head, shoulders and upper body. Do not crop; application crops it.

edit_policy.notes: Software alteration is prohibited. This profile validates existing input only; no re-encoding or editing recipe is approved. Own-device cropping is explicitly forbidden. For booth/shop, use issued code during application. File formats are unspecified by this source.

exceptions: Religious/medical head coverings are permitted; keep the face visible.
Under 6 need not face camera or use a plain expression. Under 1 need not open eyes. Support hand must not appear.
Necessary glasses must not hide eyes or cause tint, glare, reflections or shadows.
